headline: Binance Intake Falls To 194.0 Million Dollars From 545.8 Million As Exchange Intake Drops To 291.4 Million
narrative: Binance clean-asset intake fell to 194.0 million dollars from 545.8 million dollars, and intake across 79 exchanges fell to 291.4 million dollars from 695.9 million dollars. A positive pipe is dollars arriving on the venue, sell-side supply, and a negative pipe is dollars leaving, measured as the 24-hour change in holdings excluding each exchange's own token. The latest intake equals 0.1079 percent of the 270.0 billion dollars held on those venues, compared with 0.2572 percent of 270.5 billion dollars on the prior reading.
author: jordan
